crossRefs.note: When the mourning was past, David sent and took her home to his house, and she became his wife, and bore him a son. But…
Yes, truth is lacking; and he who departs from evil makes himself a prey. Yahweh saw it, and it displeased him that…
You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal…

translations.web: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
translations.bsb: to subvert a man in his lawsuit— of these the Lord does not approve.
translations.kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth
translations.asv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
